experiments.description: A workshop repairs four executable calculator apps. A manager selects defects from observed outputs, a developer supplies expression patches, and independent regression fixtures admit or reject each repair. Run original and saved versions with your own inputs, and inspect their source, failures and measured progress.

launches.reason: An organizational autonomy demonstration: operations, purchasing and accounting under one real set of simulated rules.
launches.title: The Little Bicycle Company

launches.reason: This demonstration makes experimental inquiry the decision space: the agent chooses which sentence to probe, which vocabulary or grammar claim to propose, and when to validate it. Persistent memory consists of observed examples, proposed rules, dictionary entries and validation evidence, so later decisions can build on earlier work and revise failed claims. The agent supplies the reasoning and experiment choices; the deterministic hidden-language simulator supplies consequences under a stable vocabulary, one word order and one past-tense marker. Probes reveal one chosen translation, proposals remain unverified, and validation updates confidence from actual passed and failed checks while exposing counts and a limited counterexample. Progress is measured by tested rules and held-out translation accuracy; accuracy is currently unmeasured. In the existing public lecture viewer, students can choose probes, propose rules and validate in a local independent what-if branch without writing public history.
launches.title: Alien Language Institute

launches.reason: This new catalog type is distinct from the already running bicycle-company and alien-language: its decision space is spatial visit-order optimization on a fixed 12-by-9 obstacle grid, using only candidate, replay, and rest. A fresh Inventor / Referee council proposes a bounded nearest, axis, sweep, lookahead, or weighted heuristic; optional distance, vertical, and lookahead weights stay inside the catalog bounds. The Benchmark runner supplies deterministic consequences: identical fixed tasks, impassable walls, exact shortest paths on a four-neighbor grid, every pick visited, and a return to the depot. The Referee requires fewer training steps and no regression on the three withheld fixtures before promotion. Persistent memory is anchored in the displayed facts, observations, last_decision, champion, candidate history and archive counters, leaderboard, and timeline, with the catalog’s 64-entry memory window guiding future decisions from recorded evidence. Progress is measured by champion training distance, champion withheld distance, challengers tested, and promotions; the observed starting values are 210 steps, 154 steps, zero, and zero. For lecture interaction, an audience can nominate a permitted heuristic or bounded weight set for the next candidate, choose training-1 through training-4 for a champion replay, and inspect its visit order, path and leg distances. The council then explains the engine’s measured acceptance or rejection and uses that recorded result for the next proposal; replay exposes public training paths while withheld locations remain private.
launches.title: Warehouse Invention League

launches.reason: A distinct civic governance demonstration: joint infrastructure and relief requests compete within an audited spending envelope; a conserved upstream runoff model computes household exposure, recurring crises, wear and cumulative equity between districts.
launches.title: Flood Commons

launches.reason: A distinct artificial-life research station: spatial cellular dynamics, recurrence and translation hypotheses, controlled seed mutations, generation-level replays and reproducibility. This is separate from organizational, linguistic, route-optimization and civic environments.
launches.title: The Living Field Station

launches.reason: This environment tests the construction of an internally coherent imaginary culture. A fresh designer chooses a concrete object, a dated excavation or a revision; a deterministic curator checks ten explicit constraints against retained material evidence. Geometry is generated from the actual object parameters, and acceptance and rejection are measured separately. That creates a distinct loop of interpretation, provenance and revision with an inspectable museum collection, rather than another business ledger, routing benchmark or cellular experiment. The three civilization facts are openly declared fiction; no verdict claims real historical authenticity or artistic significance.
launches.title: Tideglass: A Museum of a Civilization That Never Was

launches.reason: Launch a compact organization whose decisions can change actual calculator behavior and be checked against independently specified examples. Keep observed failures, proposed source, and measured consequences distinct. The initial receipts already support a concrete first patch; the engine must run its review before any successful repair is recorded.
